svg.title: Hybrid retrieval from request to auditable context
svg.desc: A validated request reads a versioned graph, applies application-owned access controls, checks a scoped cache, runs selected retrieval channels sequentially, reconstructs canonical items, fuses rankings, enforces budgets, and records context and lineage.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
